properties.headline: Special Weather Statement issued October 12 at 8:51AM EDT by NWS Greenville-Spartanburg SC
properties.description:
Strong wind gusts are occurring this morning on the downwind side
of the Blue Ridge, from near Grandfather Mountain in North
Carolina, southwest along the Escarpment to near Bearwallow
Mountain in North Carolina, and even into far northeast Georgia,
including Clayton. Gusts of 35 to 50 mph may briefly
occur downwind of ridges through late morning. The winds have
brought down a few downed trees and power lines in some cases.
Take extra caution if out and about this morning, especially if
driving under tall trees or if you are in a high-profile vehicle
like a truck.

properties.areaDesc: Yavapai, AZ
properties.headline: Flood Advisory issued October 12 at 5:17AM MST until October 12 at 8:15AM MST by NWS Flagstaff AZ
properties.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall is expected.

* WHERE...Yavapai County in west central Arizona...

* WHEN...Until 815 AM MST.

* IMPACTS...Minor flooding in creeks and normally dry washes is
imminent or occurring.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 514 AM MST, Doppler radar indicated heavy rain due to
thunderstorms. Minor flooding is ongoing or expected to begin
shortly in the advisory area.
- This includes the following creeks, washes and rivers...
Little Ash Creek, Pine Creek, Tiger Creek, Banty Creek, Grapevine
Creek, Bitter Creek, Racetrack Wash, Wolf Creek, North Fork Rock
Creek, Crazy Basin Creek, Buckhorn Creek, Ash Creek, Rock Creek,
Poland Creek, Sand Creek, Buzzard Roost Creek, Munds Draw,
Arrastra Creek, Cottonwood Creek, Humbug Creek, Milk Creek,
Castle Creek, Government Spring Wash, Little Wolf Creek, Sycamore
Creek, Tussock Spring Creek, Badger Spring Wash, French Creek,
Lynx Creek, Antelope Creek, Whipsaw Creek, Towers Creek, Cherry
Creek, Minnehaha Creek, Slim Jim Creek, Boulder Creek, Winters
Wash, Little Buckhorn Creek, Dry Creek, Agua Fria River, Blowout
Creek, Amazon Gulch, Hackberry Wash, Black Canyon, Hamlin Wash,
Bear Creek, Coyote Spring, Black Canyon Creek, Yarber Wash, Cedar
Creek, North Fork Cellar Springs Creek, Hackberry Creek,
Tuscumbia Creek, Brushy Wash, Little Hackberry Wash, Turkey
Creek, Willow Creek, Big Bug Creek, East Fork Castle Creek, Oak
Wash, Slate Creek, Cienega Creek, Mineral Creek, Black Butte
Wash, and Cellar Springs Creek.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Prescott Valley, Cottonwood, Black Canyon City, Verde Village,
Clarkdale, Dewey-Humboldt, Cordes Lakes, Mayer, Spring Valley,
Jerome, Crown King, Agua Fria National Monument, Cherry, Poland
Junction, Cordes Junction, Arcosanti, Horse Thief Basin,
Bridgeport, Bumble Bee and Dead Horse Ranch State Park.
- This includes the following highways...
State Route 260 between mile markers 207 and 209. State Route 69
between mile markers 263 and 284. Interstate 17 between mile
markers 242 and 274. State Route 89A between mile markers 331 and
358.

This includes the following recreation areas andcampgrounds...
Turney Gulch Group Campground, Potato Patch Campground,
Playground Group Campground, Hazlett Hollow Campground, Powell
Springs Campground, Quail Loop Campground, Raven Loop Campground
and Black Canyon Campground.
- Additional information is available at weather.gov/flagstaff.
properties.instruction:
Be especially cautious at night when it is harder to recognize the
dangers of flooding.

Be aware of your surroundings and do not drive on flooded roads.

Low water crossings will become dangerous in heavy rain. Do not
attempt to cross flooded roads. Find an alternate route.

properties.description:
At 552 AM MDT, A flood wave was moving down the Paria River and
through Paria Canyon. At 430 AM the Paria River Gauge at US-89
indicated a rise of 3 feet as the flood wave passed, with an increase
in flow to 2200 CFS.

HAZARD...Life threatening flash flooding.

SOURCE...Gauges reported.

IMPACT...Life threatening flash flooding of creeks and streams, urban
areas, highways, streets and underpasses.

Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Paria River from just north of US-89 to the Utah/Arizona border
including Paria Canyon.

properties.areaDesc: Coconino, AZ
properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued October 12 at 4:16AM MST until October 12 at 11:15AM MST by NWS Flagstaff AZ
properties.description:
FFWFGZ

The National Weather Service in Flagstaff has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...
The Paria River in...
Coconino County in north central Arizona...

* Until 1115 AM MST /1215 PM MDT/ Tonight.

* At 416 AM MST /516 AM MDT/, a river gauge on the Paria River near
US-89 in southern Utah reported a rapid rise of 3 feet from
thunderstorms that occurred on Sunday over the Paria River. Flash
flooding is ongoing or expected to begin shortly.

HAZARD...Life threatening flash flooding. Thunderstorms producing
flash flooding in and around the Paria River.

SOURCE...River gauge reported.

IMPACT...Life threatening flash flooding of areas in and around the
Paria River.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Lees Ferry and Vermilion Cliffs National Monument.

This includes the Colorado River near mile marker 0.

This includes the following recreation areas and campgrounds...
Lees Ferry Camp Site.

This includes the following creeks, washes and rivers...
Paria River and Colorado River.
properties.instruction:
Get out of the Paria River slot canyon! Flood waters will flow down
the Paria River, reaching the confluence with the Colorado River at
Lees Ferry between 12 PM and 2 PM MST.

Get out of washes and creeks if you are camping or hiking! Flooding
is occurring or imminent and will inundate creeks and washes.

CMAMtext: NWS: FLASH FLOOD WARNING this area til 11:15 AM MST. Avoid flooded areas.
CMAMlongtext: National Weather Service: A FLASH FLOOD WARNING is in effect for this area until 11:15 AM MST. This is a dangerous and life-threatening situation. Do not attempt to travel unless you are fleeing
